title: Mini mixed finite element method for nearly incompressible linear elasticity problems
summary: This paper addresses the numerical solution of nearly incompressible linear elasticity boundary value problems and their associated eigenvalue problems. A mixed finite element formulation based on Mini element is proposed to circumvent the locking phenomenon that plagues standard low-order elements in the nearly incompressible limit. For the boundary value problem, we establish the well-posedness of mixed variational formulation and derive a priori error estimates that are uniform with respect to the Lamé constant $\underlineλ$, thereby proving the method's locking-free property.
